business.claim.kind.short: Short: some of it is missing
business.claim.photoFailed: The photo could not be sent. Try again, or send the claim without it.
business.claim.sent: Claim sent: it is on the consignment note.
business.claim.receiverClaims: Agreed {term}: the risk passed to the receiver at the origin, so the receiver claims for damage on the road, not you.
business.claim.windowClosed: The time to claim on this load has passed.
business.claim.senderClaims: No trade term passes the risk to you, so your supplier claims for goods lost or damaged on the road, not you. What you found at the handover is on its note as on yours.
business.claim.senderClaimsTerm: Agreed {term}: your supplier carries the risk until delivery, so it claims for goods lost or damaged on the road, not you. What you found at the handover is on its note as on yours.
business.claim.line.supplier: Your supplier made a claim ({kind}) {when}: it is on the note.
business.claim.line.receiver: The receiver made a claim ({kind}) {when}: it is on the note.
business.claim.mayClaimViewer: A claim can still be made on this load: a member of the business who is not a viewer makes it.
business.claim.line.open: Claim ({kind}) sent {when}, waiting for a decision.
business.claim.line.report: Claim ({kind}), {when}: the damage claim report was made — the consignment note above, frozen with your claim on it. Nobody of the network decides it; hand the note on by a link.
business.loads.fact.trackingHint: Share this with whoever is receiving it.
business.loads.noteGone: The consignment note could not be opened.
business.note.notYet: A copy of the note is kept from the moment the carrier takes the goods over. From then you can download the whole file here, and make a link to it for somebody who has no account.
business.note.fileFailed: The file could not be fetched just now. Try once more.
business.note.viewer: You can see the links to this note, but not make or cancel one. Ask an owner if you need to.
business.note.linksError: The links to this note could not be listed just now. Close the load and open it again.
business.loads.offersLede: Accepting one gives that carrier the load. The others are told.
business.loads.countered: You answered {amount}: waiting for the driver
business.loads.counterSent: Your price is with the driver
business.loads.accepted: Accepted — the carrier has the load.
business.loads.thanks: Thank you — that goes on their record.
business.pay.title: Paying the carrier
business.pay.lede: Keep the carrier’s price and invoice here, and say when it is paid. Nothing is paid through SeeBuyGet.
business.pay.ledeRun: The run’s price is {price}. Keep the carrier’s invoice here, and say when it is paid. Nothing is paid through SeeBuyGet.
business.pay.amount: What the carrier asks (empty: the agreed price)
business.pay.record: Keep track of paying the carrier
business.pay.recorded: Kept. Attach their invoice, and confirm it once it is paid.
business.runs.title: Space on runs
business.runs.lede: Trucks that are leaving anyway, with room for your goods. The price is the carrier’s own, and you pay them directly.
business.runs.openNone: No runs have room at the moment.
business.runs.waiting: {min, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} free, then {rate} {currency} an hour
business.runs.quoteLine: It would cost {price} — your load fills the truck by {binds}.
business.runs.payNote: You pay the carrier directly, the way they say above. SeeBuyGet neither bills nor holds it.
business.runs.givenBack: Given back. The carrier is told.
business.home.go.clients: The businesses you send for, and everything sent for each of them.
business.clients.title: Clients
business.clients.lede: The businesses you send for. When you post a load or book space for one of them, they are the sender on the consignment note and you are named as their agent.
business.clients.f.name: Their registered name
business.clients.f.nameHint: It goes on the consignment note as the sender.
business.clients.agentNote: Whatever you send for them names them as the sender and you as their agent — the goods are theirs, and claims follow the consignment note.
business.clients.trackHint: Hand them the tracking link — a load’s or a run booking’s: it shows where their goods are, and needs no account.
business.clients.archived: {name} is archived. What was sent for them still names them.
business.sentFor.label: Sent for
business.sentFor.ownHint: Or choose a client: they become the sender, and you their agent.
business.sentFor.agentHint: They are the sender on the consignment note; you are named as their agent.
business.sentFor.noClients: Add clients under Clients to send for them as their agent.
business.nav.heading: Business
business.exports.title: Exports
business.exports.lede: Goods leaving through a port or an airport: your forwarder’s or the airline’s booking, the road to the terminal before it closes, the box’s weight and seal, the papers — and one file your forwarder takes there. SeeBuyGet books no ship and no flight: the booking, the vessel or flight and the bill of lading or air waybill are theirs, written here as references.
business.exports.none: No exports yet. Record one once your forwarder or the shipping line has confirmed a booking.
business.exports.rowMissing: {n, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} still missing before the gate
business.exports.rowMissingAir: {n, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} still missing before the cargo terminal
business.exports.line.leaveBy: To be inside the gate at {terminal} before {cutoff}, the loaded box must leave {place} by {leaveBy} — {km} km, planned at {hours} h with time to queue at the gate.
business.exports.line.onTheRoad: On the road to {terminal}: it must be inside the gate before {cutoff}.
business.exports.byRail.title: By rail to the port
business.exports.byRail.hint: Only if the box goes to the port by train. Our truck then takes it to the rail terminal, timed to the train’s cut-off there — which must fall before the port gate closes.
business.exports.byRail.set: By train from {terminal}: the box must be there before {cutoff}. The port gate closes at {gate}.
business.exports.byRail.atPort: When the train brought it inside the port gate (UTC)
business.exports.byRail.atPortSaid: Inside the port gate since {when}, as you recorded: the line’s clock counts it inside from then.
business.exports.byRail.onTrain: Handed to the railway: on its way to the port by train.
business.exports.line.railLeaveBy: To be at {terminal} before the train’s cut-off at {cutoff}, the loaded box must leave {place} by {leaveBy} — {km} km, planned at {hours} h with time to queue at the gate.
business.exports.line.railOnTheRoad: On the road to {terminal}: it must be there before the train’s cut-off at {cutoff}.
business.exports.line.railHanded: Handed in at {terminal} for the train since {when}.
business.exports.line.railMissed: The train’s cut-off at {terminal} passed at {cutoff} without the box. Ask the railway or {party} for the next train — it must still reach the port before its gate closes.
business.exports.line.missed: The gate at {terminal} closed at {cutoff} without the box. Tell {party}: it may go on the next vessel, under a new cut-off.
business.exports.f.title: Record an export by sea
business.exports.f.hint: Copy these from your booking confirmation. SeeBuyGet carries the road to the port; the sea is your forwarder’s or the line’s.
business.exports.split.label: By sea or by air
business.exports.search.label: Search the exports
business.exports.search.placeholder: Code, container, booking or air waybill, ship or flight, goods, port, country, company
business.exports.f.bookingHint: Booked with your forwarder or the shipping line — never through SeeBuyGet.
business.exports.f.utc: Write the cut-offs in UTC, as they are shown everywhere on SeeBuyGet.
business.exports.f.terminal: The terminal it is delivered to
business.exports.f.depot: Where the empty is collected (if you fetch it)
business.exports.f.depotHint: Leave the depot empty when the shipping line or your forwarder brings the empty box.
business.exports.d.nothingMissing: Nothing missing: everything your forwarder needs at the gate is here.
business.exports.d.missingAir: Still missing before the cargo terminal: {what}.
business.exports.d.nothingMissingAir: Nothing missing: everything your forwarder needs at the cargo terminal is here.
business.exports.line.airLeaveBy: To be at {terminal} before the airline’s latest acceptance time, {cutoff}, the load must leave {place} by {leaveBy} — {km} km: {drive} h on the road and {buffer} h at the terminal before that time.
business.exports.line.airLeaveByInspecte: To be at {terminal} before the airline’s latest acceptance time, {cutoff}, the load must leave {place} by {leaveBy} — {km} km: {drive} h on the road, {buffer} h at the terminal before that time and {inspection} h for the plant-health inspection at the airport.
business.exports.line.airOnTheRoad: On the road to {terminal}: it must be there before the airline’s latest acceptance time, {cutoff}.
business.exports.line.airHanded: Delivered at {terminal} since {when}. Whether the airline accepted it is the airline’s word.
business.exports.line.airMissed: The airline’s latest acceptance time at {terminal} passed at {cutoff} without the cargo. Ask {party} for the next flight.
business.exports.laden.hintAir: Post the load to {terminal} once the cargo is packed: a driver sees the latest acceptance time and the air waybill. Its weight and pieces are the booking’s.
business.exports.laden.hintAirSecured: Post the load to {terminal} once the cargo is packed and secured: it goes in a closed vehicle, with a driver whose ID has been seen, and you write its seal on the load before it is collected.
business.exports.laden.postAir: Post the load to the cargo terminal
business.exports.laden.postedAir: The load to the cargo terminal is posted for a driver.
business.exports.laden.noneAir: No load to the cargo terminal yet.
business.exports.laden.sealItSecured: Secured cargo travels sealed: write the seal on load {code} under Domestic › Loads, with its three photographs, before the driver collects it.
business.exports.handover.hintAir: One page for your forwarder at the cargo terminal: the air waybill, the flights, the law of the route, the papers and the road consignment note. SeeBuyGet sends it to nobody.
business.exports.sli.airNamed: An air waybill is not negotiable: the consignee is always named, never “to order”.
business.exports.air.title: Record an export by air
business.exports.air.departsFrom: Country of the airport it leaves from, if its airport is not one we know
business.exports.air.d.departsFromLine: To the airport in {country}: exported at home and carried in bond across the border — {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} for the border planned in
business.exports.air.builtUp: Built up on airline pallets or containers — how many
business.exports.air.builtUpHint: Only where your forwarder builds the cargo up on airline pallets or containers before it leaves. They then go on a truck with a roller floor, which rolls them on and off whole. Leave it empty for loose pieces.
business.exports.air.d.builtUpLine: {n, plural, one {# airline pallet or container} other {# airline pallets or containers}} — a truck with a roller floor
business.exports.air.slotFrom: Truck slot at the terminal — from
business.exports.air.slotHint: Only where the shed gives trucks a slot. The truck is then timed to arrive by its end, which must come before the latest acceptance time.
business.exports.air.slotSaved: Saved: the truck is timed to the slot, and its driver is told.
business.exports.air.slotCleared: Cleared: the truck is timed to the latest acceptance time again.
business.exports.air.foundAtTerminal: Found when it was handed in: {found} (the booking says {pieces} pieces). Tell your forwarder or the airline now: what was not accepted may not fly on this flight.
business.exports.air.hint: Copy these from the airline’s booking confirmation. SeeBuyGet carries the road to the cargo terminal; the flight and its air waybill are the airline’s and your forwarder’s.
business.exports.air.perishable: Perishable, kept cold (flowers, fruit, vegetables, fish)
business.exports.air.notYet: Medicines and vaccines are not carried to an airport on SeeBuyGet yet.
business.exports.air.bookingHint: Booked with your forwarder or the airline — never through SeeBuyGet.
business.exports.air.awbShort: Eleven digits: the airline’s three, and eight more.
business.exports.air.awbWrong: The last digit does not check: look at the number again.
business.exports.air.airline: Airline (only if we do not know its prefix)
business.exports.air.kind.master: The airline’s, under which our forwarder groups cargo
business.exports.air.kind.direct: The airline’s, made out to us direct
business.exports.air.queuedWarn: The truck may go, but the cargo may not fly on this flight: the risk of being left behind is yours. It is said on the export, the driver’s job and the papers.
business.exports.air.handler: Who receives it at the airport
business.exports.air.latHint: The latest acceptance time is on the airline’s confirmation: the cargo must be accepted at the terminal before it. Write it in UTC, as times are shown everywhere on SeeBuyGet.
business.exports.air.unsecured: Not secured: the terminal screens it
business.exports.air.secured: Secured by a regulated agent or known consignor
business.exports.air.securedHint: Secured cargo goes in a closed vehicle that locks, sealed where it is loaded, with a driver whose ID has been seen. Its security status is theirs to give, never SeeBuyGet’s.
business.exports.air.unsecuredHint: Not secured cargo is screened when it reaches the terminal, which takes time there.
business.exports.air.inspection: The plant-health inspection is at the airport (about 3 hours before the latest acceptance time)
business.exports.air.terminal: The cargo terminal it is delivered to
business.exports.air.confirmedNote: Recorded: the airline confirmed the booking. The driver’s job says so.
business.exports.air.moveHint: The airline moved it: give the flight it is booked on now and its latest acceptance time, from the new confirmation. The booking as it stood is kept, and a driver already on the way is told.
business.exports.air.movedNote: Recorded: the new flight and its latest acceptance time. The clock follows it.
business.exports.air.former: Booked {n, plural, one {once} other {# times}} before — last on {last}.
business.exports.air.regime.none: No air convention joins these two countries: the airline’s own conditions govern.
business.exports.air.regime.domestic: Carriage within one country: its own law governs.
business.exports.air.regime.unknown: We have not read the law of this route yet.
business.exports.air.d.asGiven: airline as you gave it: we do not hold its prefix
business.exports.air.d.securedBy: Secured by {who}{number} — their status, not SeeBuyGet’s
business.exports.air.d.notSecured: Not secured: screened at the terminal
business.exports.air.electronicYes: The air waybill may be electronic on this route.
business.exports.air.electronicNo: On this route the air waybill should be on paper: the older convention asks for one.
business.exports.air.mismatchTitle: Where it disagrees with your papers
business.exports.air.lawMissingTitle: What the law asks of the waybill, and it lacks
business.seals.requiredSecured: Secured air cargo travels sealed: {company} secured it, and its seal is checked at the cargo terminal.
business.exports.box.title: The box
business.exports.box.numberHint: Write the box’s number once the depot released it or it is at your place: the terminal gates it in by its number.
business.exports.empty.hint: Fetch the empty from {depot} against release {release}.
business.exports.empty.posted: The empty run is posted for a driver.
business.exports.empty.brought: The shipping line or your forwarder brings the empty box.
business.exports.vgm.title: The verified gross mass
business.exports.vgm.hint: A packed box is not loaded on a ship without its verified gross mass. Weigh it and sign for it here: your forwarder declares it to the line — SeeBuyGet sends nothing to a line.
business.exports.vgm.notYet: Not declared yet: the exporter weighs the packed box and signs for it.
business.exports.vgm.method1: Method 1 — the packed box weighed whole
business.exports.vgm.method2: Method 2 — the contents weighed, plus the box’s tare
business.exports.vgm.saved: The verified gross mass is recorded.
business.exports.papers.title: The papers
business.exports.papers.hint: The papers this export holds — yours, or their references; SeeBuyGet issues none and files nothing with customs. Upload a file on its line, or attach one of your documents. The export entry is the number your clearing agent gives you.
business.exports.papers.groupKept: Kept with the export, when there is one
business.exports.papers.noneAsked: Nothing asked for yet. Plants, food, hazardous goods, a buyer’s terms or the border can ask for more — put each on the list below.
business.exports.papers.askOtherPh: Its name, as the buyer or the border calls it
business.exports.papers.asked: It is on the list, counted as missing until it is given.
business.exports.papers.uploaded: The file is on your record and on the export.
business.exports.papers.uploadFailed: The file could not be put on your record.
business.exports.sli.title: Shipper’s letter of instruction
business.exports.sli.lede: What you tell your forwarder, from which it drafts the bill of lading. Most of it comes from this export; fill in the rest and sign it. Signed, it is kept exactly as signed — a change is a new version, and the earlier ones stay readable.
